ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of low-intensity dark pixels (~85-90%) with localized high-intensity white pixel clusters and streaks creating a high macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark base (near-black). High-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated on the outer distal edge of the left lobe. Distributed high-intensity linear white filaments concentrated in the lower ventral region of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central indentation with an approximate pixel angle of 48 degrees; vertex depth is significant relative to the adjacent lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary with high-frequency serrations; peak-to-valley amplitude varies between 5 to 20 pixels across the visible continuous linear edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe shows a pronounced convex upward curve towards the distal tip; right lobe shows a symmetrical convex trajectory before the distal region is occluded by water splash.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial cluster of 30+ white circular pixel groupings along the outer left lateral margin. Smaller, individual white circular spots (5-10 pixel diameter) are scattered across the interior dark surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast white linear pixel streaks (rake marks) ranging from 20 to 150 pixels in length, primarily oriented vertically and diagonally across the lower dark-pigmented regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense biological encrustation (barnacle clusters) along the outer left margin and extensive multi-directional white linear scarring (rake marks) on the fluke's ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density accumulation of calcified-looking white clusters specifically on the far upper-left edge, creating a distinctively thickened and jagged distal profile.
